Extract one event from this Russian official news body. Return ONLY JSON with keys publication_date,event_date,available_from,region,municipality_id,municipality_name,event_type,severity,confidence,evidence_quote. Dates YYYY-MM-DD or null. publication_date and region must equal supplied metadata. available_from is publication_date plus one day (scenario). municipality_id must be null: a separate official dictionary resolves it. event_date null unless explicit calendar date in evidence_quote; never infer onset from publication. event_type one of flood,fire,evacuation,emergency,pollution,unknown. severity unknown unless explicitly supported. confidence between 0 and 1. evidence_quote must be a literal substring of the supplied body supporting event_type and municipality_name; do not paraphrase. If no support, null municipality_name, unknown event_type and empty evidence_quote. No future observed event dates.
